four_layer_diagnosis.environment: too sparse -- CausalGridWorldV2's action->effect structure IS a 4-entry lookup table, so the Richens & Everitt shift class (a causal-structure shift under which a GENUINE causal model can hold accuracy while a shortcut cannot) is not instantiable here. The driver states this itself. A permutation of a 4-entry table is equally re-fittable by either kind of model, so the environment cannot carry the discrimination the criterion asks for.
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: under-instrumented -- three specific gaps. (1) No unshifted-env / scratch-model ceiling arm, so a sub-floor D2 recovery cannot be separated from budget insufficiency (the driver names this as its OPEN RESIDUAL LIMITATION and deliberately did not fix it). (2) The 0.05 absolute floor is pre-registered and legitimate but arbitrary with respect to what a 120-step budget SHOULD achieve. (3) The manipulation is n=1: all five seeds apply the identical rotation_offset=1 4-cycle; 23 of the 24 permutations are unsampled, so seed variance measures env/init noise, not shift-instance variance.
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: isolated -- the agent is constructed but never driven; transitions come from RandomPolicy and the comparator is scored offline. ARC-065-style behavioural diversity in the main agent path and ARC-037's E3/E1 routing are both outside the loop.
four_layer_diagnosis.scale: adequate for PRE_BASE (6600 optimizer steps over 28000 transitions), likely insufficient for POST_READAPT (120 optimizer steps = 1.82% of the pre fit; the manifest's '~13% of the original epoch budget' framing is epoch-based and overstates the gradient budget 7.3x, because a post-shift epoch is 15 batches against the pre fit's 110).

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: Corollary-discharge / efference-copy comparator on the world-consequence stream: posterior-parietal and MD-thalamus/colliculus outcome-prediction loops (Sommer & Wurtz), with right supramarginal gyrus showing a decoding PREFERENCE for self-other attribution over sensorimotor information (Ohata et al. 2020, Cereb Cortex).
dependencies: a trained forward model of action consequences
balanced exposure to agent-caused and externally-caused world change
a re-calibration pathway with a plasticity budget matched to the perturbation (prism / visuomotor-rotation adaptation timescales)
a readout that separates attribution-specific from action-specific variance
biological_reference.divergence: Two-layer. The comparator MECHANISM is a biological translation and is not the formal import. The failing CRITERION is: Richens & Everitt's theorem is a statement about a regret-bounded agent facing a decision problem, and it converts 'has a causal model' into 'is robust under distributional shift'. Importing that criterion into a 4-entry-lookup gridworld imports the philosophy and loses the mechanism -- there is no compositional causal structure for a genuine model to be robust ABOUT, which is why D1 is undecidable here and why D2's floor is unanchored. This is the SD-003 pattern (formal-definition import producing repeated uninterpretable FAILs) appearing at the level of the TEST rather than the mechanism, and it is worth naming as such before another letter is queued. Second, smaller divergence: biological re-calibration to a sensorimotor remapping takes hundreds of trials of error-driven plasticity; this run supplied a biologically plausible DATA budget (3600 post-shift transitions) with an implausibly small OPTIMISATION budget (120 gradient steps).
biological_reference.lit_status: present for SD-031 (targeted_review_sd_031, 3 entries: Ohata 2020, Wen 2023, Christensen 2018; plus 2 SD-031-naming entries in targeted_review_connectome_mech_256) and present for EXT-005 (targeted_review_ext_005, 5 entries including Richens & Everitt 2024, the paper that motivated this design) and present for MECH-095 (targeted_review_connectome_mech_095, 14 entries); ABSENT for ARC-037, which has no dedicated targeted review and appears only incidentally inside 3 EXT-005 entries.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [V3-EXQ-1001, 2026-09-04, autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1001_2026-09-04] OOD sequel to V3-EXQ-995. The SD-031 comparator residual was scored post-shift after a one-time 4-cycle rotation of CausalGridWorldV2's instance-level _action_map that holds surface statistics fixed (max class-fraction deviation 0.0079 against a 0.05 tolerance). FAIL, 0/2 load-bearing criteria, 5 seeds, all 10 readiness preconditions met. Frozen: MOVE_OK AUROC 0.5198, i.e. +0.0198 over chance and -0.0040 against its OWN action-shuffled control -- zero-shot, the action-conditioned component contributes nothing. Readapted (8 epochs on 15% of post-shift data): 0.5408, +0.0408 over chance and +0.0117 over shuffled, both consistent in sign across 5/5 seeds and 10x / 2.5x their own SDs, both roughly 4x BELOW the pre-registered 0.05 absolute floor -- so the FAIL is decided by the absolute floor, not by noise. THREE READING CONSTRAINTS, all from the run's own record. (i) The gap-vs-bare clause both criteria PASS is hollow: post-shift bare sits at 0.4442, below chance in 5/5 seeds, so beating it by 0.078-0.099 certifies nothing; the operative clauses are chance and shuffled-action, exactly as the 2026-09-03 red-team fix intended. (ii) D1 is analytically undecidable here -- the driver's own SCOPE LIMITATION concedes that no model, causal or correlational, can be zero-shot invariant to a relabelled 4-entry lookup table, so D1's FAIL is predicted equally by both hypotheses and carries no discriminating information. (iii) D2's FAIL is budget-unanchored: the run has no unshifted-env or scratch-model ceiling (the driver's own OPEN RESIDUAL LIMITATION, deliberately out of scope), and the readapt budget is 1.82% of the original fit in optimizer steps (120 vs 6600) -- the manifest's '~13% of the epoch budget' framing is epoch-based and overstates the gradient budget 7.3x. The run's genuine, non-confounded negative signal is a DISSOCIATION, consistent in 5/5 seeds: the 120-step pass recovered 44.2% of the shift-induced forward-MSE degradation but only 17.0% of the AUROC degradation (per-seed MSE 0.39-0.52 vs AUROC 0.13-0.20), so the residual's discriminative content does not track its forward-prediction quality under re-derivation. That is a real finding about the comparator and it is what makes the direction `mixed` rather than `non_contributory`; it is not sufficient for `weakens` because the ceiling arm that would price it is missing. Note also that this run's PRE_BASE arm REPRODUCES V3-EXQ-995's BASE arm bit-identically (AUROC 0.64365963683816507 in both, gap-vs-bare identical to 1 ulp) across a substrate-commit change e82e328 -> 1a82903: that is a determinism and substrate-stability confirmation, NOT independent corroboration, and must not be counted as a second supporting run for 995's in-distribution result. Manipulation coverage is n=1: all five seeds apply the identical rotation_offset=1 permutation, so seed variance is env/init noise only. [CORRECTIONS at the red-team pass, 2026-09-04: (F2) SD-031's genuine experimental record is V3-EXQ-1001 ALONE -- V3-EXQ-995 tagged EXT-005 only, so there is no prior SD-031 support and 1001's PRE_BASE arm reproducing 995's BASE arm bit-identically is a determinism datum, not a second support; a 'weakens' stamp would make this single run the whole record. (F4) The two operative clauses miss the pre-registered floor by different margins: D2 gap_vs_chance 0.0408 vs 0.05 (1.23x below), D2 gap_vs_shuffled 0.0117 vs 0.05 (4.3x below); ~75% of the readapt AUROC gain is action-conditioned (gap_vs_shuffled -0.004 -> +0.012), which is the better basis for 'mixed' than the MSE/AUROC recovery dissociation (44.2% vs 17.0%), itself a shortcut-consistent pattern. H2 (starved re-derivation) is a HYPOTHESIS, not an established reading. (F5) The shuffled-action control is a single permutation draw per arm; the 995-vs-1001 PRE_BASE shuffled deltas reach 0.0103 per seed, the same order as D2's 0.0117, so '5/5 seeds, 2.5x sd' overstates its precision.]

live_hypotheses: H1: the SD-031 residual's in-distribution discrimination IS a correlational shortcut riding the training-time action->effect mapping -- it does not re-derive to a genuine action-conditioned signature at ANY budget under relabelling.

H2: the re-derivation is real but was starved -- 120 optimizer steps is 1.82% of the original fit, and the 0.05 absolute floor has no ceiling anchor, so the sub-floor recovery reflects the budget rather than the architecture.

H3: the environment cannot instantiate the criterion -- a 4-entry action->displacement lookup table has no compositional causal structure for a genuine model to be robust ABOUT, so no version of this test in CausalGridWorldV2 can discriminate H1 from H2.

suggested_probes.sketch: Scratch-initialised model given the IDENTICAL post-shift readapt budget (120 optimizer steps on the same 3600 post-shift transitions, same seeds) as the discriminating control; keep the unshifted-env arm only as the asymptote row (its gap-vs-shuffled is PRE_BASE's own ~0.119, which this run already holds). Declared null: readapt-from-PRE_BASE gap-vs-shuffled <= scratch-at-same-budget gap-vs-shuffled + 1 sd (no positive transfer from the pre-shift weights) -> H1 (memorised lookup / correlational shortcut) STANDS; readapt >> scratch (positive transfer) -> H1 refuted and H2 (starved re-derivation of a real model) gains. Also record the shuffled control over >= 5 permutation draws per arm (F5) so the gap-vs-shuffled sd is a permutation sd, not a single-draw artefact.

Budget ladder on the readapt pass: cross {2, 8, 30, 60} epochs x {5%, 15%, 50%, 100%} of the post-shift transitions, DV = gap-vs-shuffled and gap-vs-chance as a function of realised optimizer steps. Declared null: gap-vs-shuffled is FLAT in budget (slope indistinguishable from zero across a 100x step range), which would refute H2 and leave H1 standing. A monotone rise crossing 0.05 refutes H1.
suggested_probes.declared_null: d(gap-vs-shuffled)/d(log optimizer steps) indistinguishable from zero over a 100x range

suggested_probes.sketch: Repeat the frozen/readapt contrast in an environment whose action->effect mapping is STATE-DEPENDENT or compositional (e.g. displacement conditioned on terrain or on an agent-carried state variable), and shift only a SUBSET of the structure so a model that has learned the composition CAN hold accuracy on the unshifted subset while a lookup-memoriser cannot. Declared null: the frozen arm's gap-vs-shuffled on the UNSHIFTED subset is at parity with its gap on the shifted subset -- i.e. the comparator is a flat lookup even where composition was available.
suggested_probes.declared_null: frozen gap-vs-shuffled on the unshifted structural subset == gap on the shifted subset, within 1 sd

fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1. Three distinct axis families (instrumentation via `measurement`, process via `curriculum`, world via `environment`) -- no family is re-entered, so this is opening fresh territory rather than circling. Do NOT queue a straight power-bump of the braked design (more seeds of the same rotation at the same budget): it would inherit both the missing ceiling and the undecidable D1. Design-audit the three legs for coverage and verdict-aliasing before queuing; H1 and H2 share the readapt machinery and could be run as one driver with the control arm and the ladder as separate arm sets, which is cheaper and keeps them paired on the same seeds -- if so, keep their declared nulls distinct in the manifest so the legs resolve independently.
fanout_recommendation.revision_note_2026_09_04: Red-team F1 accepted: the original H1 leg's declared null (shifted-readapt >= unshifted-control - 1 sd) was already falsified ~10x by this run's cells because the unshifted arm has nothing to recover; the scratch-at-same-budget arm (the driver's own OPEN RESIDUAL LIMITATION option 1) is the one that separates H1 from H2.

learning_extracted: MEASUREMENT GAP (primary): an absolute PASS floor on a recovery-under-shift DV is uninterpretable without a same-budget positive-control ceiling. The driver named this as its OPEN RESIDUAL LIMITATION and shipped anyway; the run then failed exactly on that clause. The two cheap non-vacuity gates it substituted (shift_degrades_frozen_forward_fit, readapt_does_not_regress_frozen_fit) rule out the degenerate zero-recovery case and nothing more -- they cannot price a sub-floor recovery, and both passed while the criterion they were standing in for failed.

MEASUREMENT GAP (secondary): a budget described in EPOCHS is not a budget. 8/60 epochs reads as 13%; in optimizer steps it is 120/6600 = 1.82%, because a post-shift epoch is 15 batches against the pre fit's 110. Any future re-derivability criterion should be pre-registered in optimizer steps or gradient-sample-count, never epochs across differently-sized datasets.

ENVIRONMENT GAP: the Richens & Everitt robustness criterion needs an environment with causal structure to be robust ABOUT. In a 4-entry action->displacement lookup table the criterion degenerates -- a permutation is equally re-fittable by a genuine model and by a memoriser, and zero-shot invariance is impossible for both. The driver diagnosed this correctly in its SCOPE LIMITATION and narrowed the claimed interpretation, but a narrowed interpretation does not restore the criterion's discriminating power; it only prevents over-reading a PASS. The same honesty should have been applied to reading a FAIL.

BIOLOGY DIVERGENCE, load-bearing: this is the SD-003 pattern relocated. SD-003 imported a formal definition (Pearl two-pass counterfactual) into a mechanism and burned 28 FAILs before supersession. Here the mechanism is a faithful biological translation and the FORMAL IMPORT IS IN THE TEST -- a regret-bound theorem about decision-problem agents, applied to an offline residual-AUROC probe in a lookup-table world. Formal imports get the philosophy right and the mechanism wrong at whatever level they enter; the test level is not exempt.

GENUINE POSITIVE SIGNAL WORTH KEEPING: the 120-step pass recovered 44.2% of the shift-induced forward-MSE degradation but only 17.0% of the AUROC degradation, 5/5 seeds, MSE > AUROC in every seed. The comparator's discriminative content does not track its forward-prediction quality under re-derivation. That dissociation is the run's most durable output, it is not explained by budget starvation alone (the budget was large enough to move MSE substantially), and it should be a RECORDED READOUT in the successor rather than a derived endpoint comparison.

MEASUREMENT CAVEAT for the whole family: post-shift AND pre-shift bare change-magnitude sits BELOW chance in the MOVE_OK stratum (0.4295-0.4550 across all 15 arm rows). The gap-vs-bare clause therefore certifies nothing on its own -- an uninformative comparator at AUROC 0.5 clears a 0.05 gap-vs-bare floor against a 0.44 reference automatically. The 2026-09-03 red-team fix caught this prospectively; the lesson generalises to any successor in the 995/1001 family, and to the EXT-005 evidence note.

RECORDING GAP, minor: the run-pack metrics.json is an empty values map. Adjudication was not blocked (the pack manifest carries evidence_direction and evidence_direction_per_claim), but no headline metric is exposed in the pack's metrics channel. Cite the Experimental Recording Standard and populate it in the successor.

DESIGN COVERAGE: five seeds of the SAME permutation is n=1 on the manipulation axis. Seed variance here measures env/init noise, not shift-instance variance. The successor should sample several permutations (and, per H3, several structural subsets).

PROVENANCE: a same-driver reproduction of a predecessor's arm is not corroboration. 1001's PRE_BASE arm reproduces 995's BASE arm bit-identically (AUROC identical to 17 significant figures) across a substrate-commit change. That is a valuable substrate-stability datum and it must not be counted as a second independent support for 995's in-distribution result.

proposed_question.title: Is SD-031's comparator residual a genuine action-conditioned causal signature, or a correlational shortcut riding the training-time action->effect mapping -- and can the current test bed tell?

decision.decision_question: Does REE's SD-031 comparator satisfy the Richens & Everitt robustness-under-shift criterion for possessing an approximate causal model of its own action effects?
decision.live_gate: a post-shift readapted gap-vs-own-shuffled-action that reaches a same-budget unshifted-env ceiling within noise
decision.distance_phrase: blocked on a missing same-budget positive control; one fan-out portfolio away from decidable
decision.observation_bottleneck: CausalGridWorldV2's action->effect structure is a 4-entry lookup table, so the criterion may be uninstantiable in the current test bed regardless of budget (H3).

hypotheses.label: the residual's discrimination is a correlational shortcut riding the training-time action->effect map
hypotheses.desc: The in-distribution AUROC 0.644 signature is memorised action->effect association, not a re-derivable action-conditioned model; it does not recover to a same-budget ceiling under relabelling at any budget.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-1001 is consistent with this leg but cannot establish it: the run had no same-budget ceiling arm, so a sub-floor recovery is not separable from H-budget.

hypotheses.label: the re-derivation is real but the readapt budget was starved
hypotheses.desc: 120 optimizer steps is 1.82% of the original 6600-step fit; the observed +0.0117 gap-vs-shuffled and +0.0408 gap-vs-chance are the budget's output, and recovery scales with budget toward the pre-shift 0.1194.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-1001 is consistent with this leg too: the same 120-step pass recovered 44.2% of the forward-MSE degradation, so the budget was demonstrably non-trivial and the AUROC recovery of 17.0% has no ceiling to be judged against.

hypotheses.label: the environment cannot instantiate the Richens criterion at all
hypotheses.desc: A 4-entry action->displacement lookup table has no compositional causal structure to be robust about; a permutation of it is equally re-fittable by a genuine model and by a memoriser, and zero-shot invariance is impossible for both. If this holds, no budget or control arm in CausalGridWorldV2 discriminates H-shortcut from H-budget.

resolution.basis: Asserted by the V3-EXQ-1001 driver's own SCOPE LIMITATION and confirmed by D1's structure: D1's FAIL is predicted identically by H-shortcut and H-budget, so at least one criterion in this test bed is already known to be undecidable.
